build_steps.description: Install system packages: git, curl, python3, python3-pip, python3-venv, ca-certificates
Execute repo_setup.sh to materialize /workspace from git repository
Execute setup_runtime.sh to install kubectl and poetry

runtime_artifacts.workspace_materialization: repo_setup.sh clones repository at build time
runtime_artifacts.runtime_setup: setup_runtime.sh installs kubectl v1.31.0 and poetry
runtime_artifacts.verifier_assets: eval.sh and tests/ are runtime-mounted, not baked into image

container_build_plan.notes: Dockerfile.final is the single authoritative packaging spec. Verifier assets (eval.sh, test.patch, tests/) are mounted at runtime, not baked into the image.
